token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

id.desc: ID of the usergroup to fetch

feature_not_enabled.desc: The Admin APIs feature is not enabled for this workspace.

invalid_auth.desc: The workspace specified is not part of this organization.

restricted_action.desc: The calling user is not allowed to view the specified usergroup.

not_an_enterprise.desc: The token passed in does not belong to an Enterprise organization.

invalid_usergroup.desc: A usergroup with the specified ID does not exist.
